name: bayan
reference: Aref, Mostajabdaveh, Chheda. Bayan algorithm: exact and approximate community detection via modularity maximization. 2024. (bayanpy, Gurobi)

resolution.doc: Modularity resolution gamma. 1.0 is standard modularity; tuned as the granularity knob, like Louvain.

threshold.doc: Optimality-gap tolerance: Bayan stops once the branch-and-cut proves it is within this of optimal. A quality/time tolerance, not a tuned hyperparameter; set-only.
